privacy.title: Politiki y'ibanga
privacy.subtitle: Incamake isobanutse y'uko Urugo iteganya gukusanya no gukoresha amakuru ku rubuga rwayo no mu mbonerahamwe z'ubukode.
privacy.provisionalNote: Inyandiko y'agateganyo — itegereje isuzuma ry'amategeko: Iyi Politiki y'ibanga ni inyandiko y'ibanze igenewe igerageza rya sisitemu kandi izasuzumwa n'inzobere mu mategeko mbere yo gutangira gukoreshwa ku mugaragaro.

about.heading: Ibyerekeye Urugo
about.p1: Urugo ni urubuga rw'inzu zikodeshwa rwubakiwe gufasha abantu kubona inzu mu Rwanda no gufasha ba nyir'inzu gutangaza inzu cyangwa gucunga ubukode kuva kwimuka kugeza gusohoka.

info.heading: Amakuru utanga
info.p1: Iyo ufunguye konti, utangaje inzu, usabye gusura inzu, wohereje ikibazo, cyangwa ucunga amasezerano y'ubukode kuri Urugo, ushobora gutanga amazina yawe, nomero ya telefoni, imeyili, amakuru y'inzu, n'inyandiko z'ubukode.
info.p2: Muri iki cyiciro cy'igerageza ry'urubuga, bimwe mu bikorwa bibikwa muri mushakisha yawe kugira ngo ubashe kubigerageza. Ububiko bwa seriveri, kwemeza imyirondoro, n'amamenyesha nyakuri bizagengwa na politiki ya nyuma imaze gusuzumwa n'amategeko mbere yo gutangira ku mugaragaro.

use.heading: Uko amakuru agenewe gukoreshwa
use.p1: Amakuru yinjijwe kuri Urugo agamije guhuza abashaka inzu na ba nyir'inzu, gutegura gahunda zo gusura inzu, kubika amasezerano y'ubukode n'ubwishyu ku murongo, no gushyigikira isuzuma ry'amateka y'ubukode.
use.p2: Ba nyir'inzu bakoresha Urugo bashobora guhitamo niba nomero ya telefoni, WhatsApp, cyangwa imeyili yabo bigaragara ku nzu batangaje.

sharing.heading: Gusangira no kugaragara kw'amakuru
sharing.p1: Amakuru rusange y'inzu nk'aho iherereye, ubukode bw'ukwezi, amafoto, n'ibikorwa remezo agaragarira buri wese usura Urugo. Amakuru yo guhamagarana n'inyandiko zihariye z'ubukode bigenewe gusa nyir'inzu, umupangayi bireba, cyangwa abakozi babifitiye uburenganzira igihe ububiko nyakuri buzatangira.

choices.heading: Amahitamo yawe
choices.p1: Ushobora gushakisha inzu ziri ku rubuga udafite konti. Ku makuru y'igerageza abitswe muri mushakisha yawe, ushobora kuyasiba igihe cyose. Igihe konti nyakuri zizatangira, uzabasha kuvugurura cyangwa gusaba gusiba amakuru ya konti yawe.

meta.title: Amabwiriza y'imikoreshereze (Inyandiko y'agateganyo)
meta.description: Amabwiriza y'imikoreshereze y'agateganyo agenewe abashaka inzu, ba nyir'inzu, n'abapangayi bakoresha Urugo.

terms.title: Amabwiriza y'imikoreshereze
terms.subtitle: Ibiteganyijwe bisobanutse ku bashaka inzu, ba nyir'inzu, n'abapangayi bakoresha Urugo.
terms.provisionalNote: Inyandiko y'agateganyo — itegereje isuzuma ry'amategeko: Aya Mabwiriza y'imikoreshereze ni inyandiko y'ibanze igenewe igerageza rya sisitemu kandi izasuzumwa n'inzobere mu mategeko mbere yo gutangira gukoreshwa ku mugaragaro.

scope.heading: Imiterere ya serivisi za Urugo
scope.p1: Urugo itanga ibikoresho byo gushakisha inzu zikodeshwa, guhuza abashaka inzu na ba nyir'inzu, no gufasha ba nyir'inzu kwamamaza inzu (Kwamamaza gusa) cyangwa gucunga amasezerano y'ubukode, ubwishyu, n'abapangayi (Gucunga ubukode bwose).
scope.p2: Urugo ni urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga kandi ntiruri mu bagize amasezerano y'ubukode hagati ya nyir'inzu n'umupangayi.

landlord.heading: Inshingano za ba nyir'inzu
landlord.p1: Ba nyir'inzu batangaza inzu kuri Urugo bafite inshingano yo gutanga ibisobanuro by'ukuri, amafoto, ibiciro, n'uko inzu iboneka.
landlord.p2: Ba nyir'inzu bahisemo Kwamamaza gusa bakurikirana amasura y'inzu, amasezerano, n'ubwishyu ku giti cyabo. Ba nyir'inzu bahisemo Gucunga ubukode bwose bakomeza kugira inshingano yo kugenzura ubwishyu no kubahiriza amategeko y'ubukode.

renter.heading: Inshingano z'abashaka inzu n'abapangayi
renter.p1: Abashaka inzu bagomba gusura inzu imbona nkubone kandi bakemeranya na nyir'inzu ku masezerano y'ubukode mbere yo kwishyura ingwate cyangwa ubukode.
renter.p2: Abapangayi bakoresha ibikoresho byo gucunga ubukode bya Urugo bafite inshingano yo gutanga ibihamya by'ubwishyu by'ukuri no kumenyesha ibikeneye gusanwa cyangwa impaka mu kuri.

history.heading: Amateka y'ubukode n'impaka
history.p1: Imenyesha ryose ry'umwenda w'ubukode ryanditswe kuri Urugo rigamije guha umupangayi igihe gisobanutse cyo kwishyura cyangwa kuvuguruza iyo nyandiko afite ibimenyetso mbere y'uko yemezwa.

preview.heading: Icyiciro cy'igerageza n'impinduka
preview.p1: Bimwe mu bice by'urubuga rwa Urugo ubu bikora mu buryo bw'igerageza bikoresheje amakuru y'urugero mu gihe seriveri zirimo guhuzwa. Ibirimo n'aya mabwiriza y'agateganyo bishobora guhinduka mbere yo gutangira ku mugaragaro.

replies.landlordContent:
Urugo itanga uburyo bubiri kuri nyir'inzu kuri konti imwe:

• Kwamamaza gusa: Tangaza inzu zifite amafoto, ibiciro, n'uko ziboneka, kandi usubize ibibazo n'amasura y'inzu ku giti cyawe.
• Gucunga ubukode bwose: Ongeramo abapangayi, amasezerano y'ubukode, gukurikirana ubwishyu bwa Mobile Money, n'amateka y'ubukode igihe cyose ubishakiye.
replies.moveInContent:
Mbere yo kwimuka, ba nyir'inzu i Kigali bakunze gusaba:

• Ubukode bw'ukwezi bwishyurwa mbere (akenshi ukwezi 1 kugeza ku mezi 3 bitewe n'inzu)
• Ingwate isubizwa (akenshi ihwanye n'ubukode bw'ukwezi 1)

Fungura ipaji y'inzu iyo ari yo yose urebe ikiguzi cyo kwimuka n'ibiguzi by'ukwezi mbere yo gusaba gusura inzu.
replies.visitContent: Ushobora gushakisha inzu zose ziri ku rubuga rwa Urugo udafite konti. Nubona inzu ukunze, fungura amakuru yayo maze uhitemo Saba gusura inzu cyangwa Ohereza ikibazo kugira ngo uvugane na nyir'inzu imbona nkubone.
